conservatism_note: Measured excess had not plateaued at the clean cutoff (smoothed 130,296/day, still rising ~19K/wk). An independent convolution model of the same effect lands near 220,000/day, so the flat 200,000 ceiling is a standing haircut of roughly 20K/day.
